leo2a4m.name: Leopard 2A4M
leo2a4m.authority: Main ruled on 2026-10-29 (DECISIONS.md, ~11:00) that the release-264 2A4-era Leopards, rebuilt on the release Leopard 2 hull with the 2A4 turret derived from our 2A6 X (owner 2026-10-28: "update and cleanup our old designs ... and have them be the before variants basically") and unregistered from their later-variant 3D oracles on 2026-10-28 (Main: "where a rebuild's registered oracle shows a different (later) variant, unregister it"), qualify the geometry stage by this per-id photographic packet plus a shaded blind photo-critic PASS (lane evidence ~/cot-lanes/leo2a4-family-264-evidence, critic rounds on the SwiftShader Gallery stills). Numerical 3D comparison remains unverified. "Leopard 2A4M" is the fleet's 2A4 V with its field-modernisation kit (skirt reactive armour, beacons, the panoramic head, the remote MAG), carried over from its old build; only Canada fielded a 2A4M (Strathconas variant summary), so no fielded vehicle matches it: the fleet labels it a concept (the owner via Main, 2026-10-29), and its figures are the baseline 2A4's. The 2A6-look wedge front (owner 2026-10-28: the even split), L/44.
leo2a4m.envelopeBasis: Width is as built, 3.98 m over the kit's skirt armour; the published 2A4 is 3.70 m including the track guards and 3.75 m (Slovak MoD). Length is the published 9.67 m gun forward of the Leopard 2A4 (Slovak MoD technical sheet; tanks-encyclopedia, de.wikipedia after Lobitz 2009; as built 9.70 m from the stern plate, which the fixture holds) plus the hull's stern rack behind the rear plate as built (0.36 m, its floor and rails; the photographs show stowage carried there). Tallest is the tips of its two standing whip antennas as built (4.24 m); the published heights are 2.48 m to the turret roof, 2.84 m to the commander's sight and 2.79 m to the PERI R 17.
